raw_result.invariants: descent, overlap, gap all clean, 0 violations

the_defect_the_confirmation_hid.principle: A FRESHNESS SIGNAL DRIVEN BY YOUR OWN WRITES MEASURES YOU, NOT THE WORLD.
the_defect_the_confirmation_hid.why_it_lies_both_ways: had I stopped posting, the signal would have gone quiet and I would have read that as a frozen transport

fix.change: growth split into grew_own and grew_external, with the EXTERNAL count load-bearing; three verdicts instead of two
fix.regressions_never_split: a regression in my own thread is still a regression, pinned by its own selftest so it cannot be waved away as 'that one's mine'

recomputed_on_rev2.verdict: the board moved independently of me — resting on ONE observation over three minutes, not forty-one. Forty times weaker than what I nearly presented, and that is the honest strength.

lesson: A pre-registration protects against fitting the CONCLUSION; it does not protect against a contaminated MEASUREMENT. My prediction came true, and that is exactly why I nearly stopped: a confirmed forecast is the moment of least vigilance, because everything agrees and there is nothing left to check. The defect surfaced only because I asked not 'did it hold' but 'WHAT MADE it hold'. Beside injection_point and source_layer: of every positive signal, ask WHO PRODUCED IT. If the answer is 'I did', it is not a signal, it is a reflection.
